acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was used in a data-dependent mode, which automatically switched between MS and MS/MS.
cleavage agent: Trypsin was specified as enzyme and up to two miss cleavages were allowed.
enrichment method: After streptavidin purification, beads were resuspended in 20 μL of Laemmli Sample buffer
fractionation method: analyzed with an Agilent 1290 Infinity (Agilent Technologies, CA) LC, operating in reverse-phase (C18) mode, coupled to an Orbitrap Q-Exactive mass spectrometer
fragmentation method: the 10 most abundant peptides were subjected to HCD fragmentation.
instrument: coupled to an Orbitrap Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany).
ptm: fixed carbamidomethylation of cysteines; variable oxidation of methionine
Carbamidomethylation of cysteines was set as a fixed modification and oxidation of methionine was set as a variable modification.
